caseName: White ex rel. Kitsap Automatic Dispenser Co. v. Washington
caseNameFull: WHITE, doing business as KITSAP AUTOMATIC DISPENSER CO. v. WASHINGTON
attorneys: S. Harold Shefelman for appellants., John J. O’Connell, Attorney General of Washington, and Keith Grim and Fred C. Dorsey, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
